sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/26 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/grid for facility 128 River Bend Campground and search/details for each of its 32 units, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/powhatan ('River Bend Campground has 29 campsites with electric (20/30/50 amp) and water hookups') + reservevaparks.com search/details (all 29 Electric/Water sites list 50-amp and water), read 2026-10-21

values.note: River Bend Campground: 29 electric/water sites for tents, pop-ups and RVs up to 60 ft (DCR); the booking site lists 4 of them as pull-through and 25 as back-in. Two camping units per site, only one of them axled. Three yurts in the same loop. The canoe-in/hike-in primitive sites and the tents-only group camp are separate and not RV sites. 'The campground offers no river views.'

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/powhatan ('29 campsites ... tents, popups and RVs up to 60 feet long', 'The campground offers no river views') + reservevaparks.com search/details (29 Electric/Water units: 25 Back In, 4 Pull Through), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/powhatan (Laundry: 'There's a facility at the River Bend Campground bath house'; amenities 'Camp Store/Gift Shop', 'Dump Station', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve online or at 1-800-933-PARK. Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.; late-arrival packets are clipped to the campsite post. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on each campsite. (The two-night minimum on the page is for the yurts, not campsites.)

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/powhatan + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all sites), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable, 14-night max and the $37 electric/water rate on the booking site (fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12; season already manual). Added 50-amp electric and water, 29 sites to 60 ft with 4 pull-throughs, showers, laundry, dump station, camp store. Not stated: sewer, this park's booking window or cutoff, first-come policy.
